what: Goodness-of-Fit Tests Based on Mellin Log-Cumulants
title: Goodness-of-Fit Tests Based on Mellin Log-Cumulants
text: logcumulant provides goodness--fit tests diagnostic diagrams positive-support reliability data, built Mellin log-cumulants. implements family three complementary Hotelling-type  statistics together three moment-ratio-style diagrams, calibrated parametric bootstrap reliable finite-sample inference. package built around design choices: Three nested tests. T2_(2,3) targets log-scale shape (dispersion skewness); T2_(1,2,3) adds entropy-related first log-cumulant; T2_(1,...,6) exploits higher-order log-cumulants tail discrimination. Bootstrap-first inference. discrepancy covariance typically ill-conditioned, asymptotic chi-squared reference unreliable finite samples; parametric bootstrap restores correct size. Diagnostic diagrams. Log-cumulant, kurtosis-skewness, coefficient--variation diagrams, overlaying theoretical loci six reliability families bootstrap cloud 95% concentration ellipse. Six reliability families. Weibull, Frechet, Gamma, Inverse-Gamma, Log-Normal, Log-Logistic, fitted maximum likelihood fast C++ core.

title: logcumulant 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Three nested Hotelling-type T-squared goodness--fit statistics (T2_all, T2_bootstrap) parametric-bootstrap calibration. Three diagnostic diagrams (log_cumulant_diagram, kurtosis_diagram, cv_diagram), combined panel (three_diagrams), multi-dataset overlay (multi_lc_diagram), quick plot_lc interface. Maximum-likelihood fitting six reliability families C++ core. Anderson–Darling Cramer–von Mises tests AIC via gof_compare_all. Size power simulation utilities (size_study, power_study). Nine bundled reliability datasets (reliability_datasets).
